resolvedFinding.issue: A label-only child update can leave providerStates memo cached, so an old render-time Date.now implementation could pass the intended timestamp-reuse regression.
resolvedFinding.revision2Resolution: Require memo recomputation through a fresh equivalent loading-map object while preserving parent predicate identity; observe a delegating actual permits wrapper and separate presentation timestamps from guard current-time calls.

designReview: Moving the actual Date.now read into a layout effect samples commit-time state rather than concealing an impure render call behind another function. A nullable snapshot stores only current predicate identity and timestamp; render remains deterministic for that snapshot.

The identity comparison must reject the previous scope during the render preceding the new layout effect. Absent predicate clears the snapshot without reading time. Existing loading and scoped-OpenCode guards must short-circuit before predicate evaluation.

The exact existing Launch owner constructs a fresh permits function on every parent hook render. Its unchanged expiry+1 timer invalidates that owner. A child snapshot state update alone does not recreate the parent prop, preventing a self-sustaining update cycle.

A child-only memo recomputation with stable predicate intentionally reuses the original observation time. That time is display evidence only. Original createLaunchGuard and captureForSubmit independently sample actual current time at action boundaries.

The proposed real-owner regression is feasible without any provider/API/preflight operation. A finite read-only source-selector fixture supplies the six already-required context values; construct the actual fence, seed exact proof after obtaining actual draft/selection identities, and retain the hook timer and pure predicate.

The test must check the actual parent predicate identity and observed timestamp, force child memo recomputation, reject via the original guard at strict expiry before processing the scheduled callback, then process only the original expiry owner and observe the chip leave Ready. No manually manufactured expiry render/timer may substitute.
The nine direct tests and three parameterized declarations, including the nine captured-readiness scenarios and original module mocks, remain immutable source-review obligations.

Both selected paths and the four direct readiness/guard/fence owners are already original source pins; both paths are existing explicit fast-lint operands. No source-roster or workflow expansion is indicated.
qualificationLimits: Prospective document/source diagnosis only; there are no source afterimages and no lint/compiler/frontend/E2E execution results.

The strategy relies on the existing caller fresh-identity/expiry-owner contract; it does not promise independent clock updates for arbitrary stable callbacks or change the existing expiry scheduling policy.

The current immutable ESLint config treats set-state-in-effect as warning. The selected bounded synchronization render can still produce that warning; no warning-free or compiler acceptance is asserted and no rule change is selected.
Commit-time sampling adds a local observation even if readiness evaluation is currently short-circuited; it adds no timer, recurring cadence, provider operation or mutation authority.
StrictMode development replay may repeat effect setup; the essential invariant is bounded synchronization without a parent-identity feedback loop, not a globally exact render count.
The equal1777 source vectors are source-pin evidence only. This review does not independently rehash all1777 repository bodies or transfer the failed Task Board/Team result into acceptance.
Root must rebind the immediate publication parent; preserve all incoming leaves, original size baseline/exclusions, every old test body and unchanged production authority regions in actual-source R2.
